description: Classification of semi-mode allowed commands by risk tier. Used to audit and adjust the allowlist.

T1_readonly.label: Read-only (safe)
T1_readonly.behavior: Always auto-allow in semi mode. Read-only info only.

T2_test_build.label: Test/Build (low risk)
T2_test_build.behavior: Auto-allow in semi mode. Runs tests or reads test output only.

T3_write_capable.label: Write-capable (medium risk)
T3_write_capable.behavior: Should ask in semi mode, or tightly scoped. Can write with shell redirect (>).

commands.notes: echo text > file writes via shell redirect. Consider restricting.
Write-Output text > file writes via shell redirect. Consider restricting.
npm install/ci/config modify environment. Too broad.
pip install modifies Python environment. Too broad.

findings.issue: npm * not in gate, but npm test and npm run ARE. npm install/config NOT allowed. Verify this is intended.
findings.recommendation: Add ^npm ci (safe install from lockfile) to gate and semi-agents. Keep npm test and npm run, do NOT add npm install.

findings.issue: npm * is very broad — allows npm install (downloads + runs lifecycle scripts), npm config (modifies npm config)
findings.recommendation: Replace with "npm test *", "npm run *", "npm ci *" individually. Remove broad "npm *".

findings.issue: pip * allows pip install (downloads + modifies Python packages), pip uninstall (removes packages)
findings.recommendation: Replace with "pip install --user *", "pip freeze *", "pip list *", "pip show *". Remove broad "pip *".

findings.issue: pip is broad — allows pip install, pip uninstall, etc.
findings.recommendation: Same as above: scope to specific subcommands.

findings.issue: echo with shell redirect (>) writes files. Unsafe for semi mode.
findings.recommendation: Consider removing from allowlist, or add '^echo [^-]' to prevent echo -e or similar.

findings.issue: Same as echo — shell redirect writes files.
git branch -D is explicitly set to ask. Consistent with gate (no '^git branch -D').
findings.recommendation: No change needed. Good example of explicit override.

findings.issue: git stash drop is explicitly set to ask. Consistent.
findings.recommendation: No change needed. Good example of explicit override.

recommendations.title: Tighten pip in semi-agents.json and gate
recommendations.action: Replace broad pip with scoped subcommands. Add 'pip freeze', 'pip list', 'pip show', 'pip install --user'.

recommendations.title: Review echo/Write-Output in gate only (semi-agents handles echo at gate level)
recommendations.action: Remove echo/Write-Output from gate's semiAllowPatterns. Keep in semi-agents if desired (agent-level control).

recommendations.title: Add 'npm ci' to gate allowlist
recommendations.action: Add '^npm ci' pattern to permission-gate.ps1 as safe npm install variant.

recommendations.title: Audit ask overrides in semi-agents.json
recommendations.action: Check that all 'ask' overrides (git branch -D, git stash drop) match gate deny patterns.
